tagline: One of the largest publicly-traded lodging real estate investment trusts with a diverse portfolio of iconic and market-leading hotels and resorts located in prime U.S. markets.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the hero because it represents the key operational performance of Park Hotels' strategic portfolio, with consolidated Core hotels contributing approximately 90% of adjusted hotel EBITDA. It directly reflects the company's ability to generate returns for shareholders.

kpis.name: Rooms Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of room nights at hotels and represents the substantial majority of total revenue.
kpis.description: Rooms revenue is the primary source of revenue for Park Hotels and reflects travel demand and hotel occupancy.
kpis.signal: Primary indicator of hotel operating performance.

kpis.name: Food & Beverage Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from dining services, banquets, and catering provided to hotel guests.
kpis.description: Food & beverage revenue includes group dining, restaurants, and banquet services offered within the hotels.
kpis.signal: Complementary revenue stream closely tied to occupancy.

kpis.name: RevPAR (Revenue per Available Room)
kpis.explanation: Average revenue per available room, combining average rate and occupancy to measure room performance.
kpis.description: RevPAR is a critical measure of hotel performance that reflects both volume and pricing.
kpis.signal: Key metric measuring overall room performance in the hotel industry.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of available rooms that are occupied during a given period.
kpis.description: Occupancy rate measures the effective utilization of the room portfolio and directly impacts revenue.
kpis.signal: Indicator of demand and utilization of available capacity.

kpis.name: Hotel Adjusted EBITDA - Core Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Adjusted EBITDA generated by consolidated Core hotels, representing the key operational performance of the strategy.
kpis.description: This metric measures the operational profitability of the strategic Core portfolio, excluding Non-Core activities.
kpis.signal: Approximately 90% of total adjusted hotel EBITDA, a key metric for shareholder returns.

kpis.name: Portfolio Room Count
kpis.explanation: Total number of rooms in Park Hotels' portfolio across its 34 hotels and resorts.
kpis.description: Room count reflects the size and scale of Park Hotels' real estate portfolio.
kpis.signal: Indicator of the size and capacity of the property portfolio.

kpis.name: Core Hotels Count
kpis.explanation: Number of strategic hotels in the Core portfolio, including one unconsolidated joint venture.
kpis.description: The 21 consolidated Core hotels are the foundation of Park Hotels' strategy.
kpis.signal: Indicator of strategic focus and portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Luxury & Upper Upscale Rooms %
kpis.explanation: Percentage of rooms in the Core portfolio classified as luxury or upper upscale, reflecting portfolio quality.
kpis.description: Over 96% of Core portfolio rooms are classified as luxury or upper upscale, supporting high revenue and margins.
kpis.signal: Indicator of portfolio quality and premium positioning.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: Park Hotels & Resorts, as a lodging REIT, does not have an explicit artificial intelligence positioning. The company focuses on active real estate asset management and traditional hotel operational performance.
